name: Currencies
descr: The currencies the prices of the store are written in. multiplex is the rate against the base currency - the one whose rate is 1 - and division says a sum is divided by that rate instead of multiplied. A goods points at a currency by its *_curr_id columns and the Price tool writes them; the sums already written into orders keep their own words and never follow a currency.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a currency at the end of the list. The rate comes as 1 when the call leaves it out - the program adds one the same way - so give the real multiplex right away.

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the currency: USD, EUR

params.name: multiplex
params.descr: the rate against the base currency

params.name: division
params.descr: true - a sum is divided by the rate instead of multiplied

params.name: provider_id
params.descr: id of the provider the currency belongs to; empty - common

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of currencies, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the currency, or several of them

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the currency: USD, EUR

params.name: multiplex
params.descr: the rate against the base currency

params.name: division
params.descr: true - a sum is divided by the rate instead of multiplied

params.name: provider_id
params.descr: id of the provider the currency belongs to; empty - common

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes currencies by id. The first call counts the goods priced in them, the second one does it: their *_curr_id columns are emptied, so those prices read as the base currency, and the sums already written into orders stay as written.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the currency, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

params.name: relation
params.descr: true - the references pointing at these rows are emptied as well; left out, they stay as they are

commands.name: CmdPos
commands.descr: Lays the list of the currencies in order.

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT
